entries.name: Reckless
entries.text: Gain advantage on melee attacks or damage, but enemies gain the same vs. you until your next turn.

entries.name: Dead Bone Pulse
entries.text: Bone weapons and jutsu cannot be made at disadvantage.

entries.name: Savage Battle Instincts
entries.text: Cannot be surprised; enemies can't gain advantage on attacks vs. you.

entries.name: Backstab
entries.text: With advantage, add your level to the triggering attack's damage.

entries.name: Savage Assault
entries.text: Once per turn, if you hit with a Ninjutsu attack, you can make another at -5. If that hits, attack once more. Enemies gain advantage on attacks vs. you until your next turn.

entries.name: Battle Hungry
entries.text: +1 to damage each turn you use your action to hit with a bone weapon or Kaguya Hijutsu (max +5).

entries.name: Shikotsumyaku Technique
entries.text: Twice per combat, all enemies of your choice make a Dex save vs. your Taijutsu DC or take Xd6 + mod damage and gain 3 Bleed. X = level.

entries.name: Dangerous Body
entries.text: When damaged in melee, creatures within 5 ft. take 3d6 piercing damage as bones erupt from your body.

entries.name: Passive
entries.text: Gains +1 damage per melee hit (max +5). Has a permanent bone katana (1d8 + mod).

entries.name: Very Pointy Bones
entries.text: Ignores up to 10 DR once per turn.

entries.name: Very Penetratey Bones
entries.text: Ignores temporary hit points once per turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Kaguya Jonin may make 3 attacks with its Bone Katana or 4 attacks with its Bone Kunai.

entries.name: Bone Katana
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Bone Kunai
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

The Kaguya Jonin takes one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an additional reaction. It regains all Elite Actions at the start of its turn.
